name: ABRO Expanding Polyurethane PU Foam Insulation Sealant (750ml)
shortDescription: One-component moisture-curing polyurethane expanding foam yielding up to 45 litres of high-insulation cellular foam for gap filling and acoustic/thermal sealing.
overview: ABRO Polyurethane Expanding Foam is a one-component, self-expanding, ready-to-use aerosol sealant engineered to seal large cavities, pipe penetrations, window frames, and thermal bridge gaps in building envelopes. Reacting with moisture in the atmosphere, it expands up to 40 times its original liquid volume, forming a semi-rigid closed-cell matrix with exceptional thermal insulation (R-value) and acoustic dampening properties. It bonds tenaciously to concrete, brick, plaster, wood, metal, and PVC, can be trimmed and sanded within 60 minutes, and painted over with any architectural finish.
keyFeatures: Massive yield: Expands up to 40 – 45 Litres of cured foam per 750ml canister
Superior thermal insulation with low thermal conductivity (0.036 W/mK)
High acoustic noise reduction index (dampens sounds up to 60 dB)
Tenacious primerless adhesion to concrete, brickwork, stone, wood, metal, and PVC
Cured foam can be sawed, trimmed, sanded, plastered, and painted within 1 hour
Resists water absorption, mildew, rot, and aging under building envelopes
Includes ergonomic trigger straw adapter for precise dispensing into narrow cavities
applications: Sealing large perimeter gaps around window and door frames in masonry
Filling penetrations around HVAC ducts, plumbing pipes, and electrical cables
Thermal insulation around cold storage panels, refrigeration units, and roofing eaves
Acoustic soundproofing of hollow partition walls, generator rooms, and engine bays
